changes.title: Circle suspects
items: The pause page (Esc) has a Circle-bug suspects group: an on/off for each effect centred on the witch, to find which draws the circle round her
Link switches for the same hunt: ?area=off, ?cut=pixel or ?cut=whole, and ?precision=high, medium or low

changes.title: Sigil by size
items: A happy animal's sigil lies just below its feet, whatever its size: a mouse's close, an elephant's further off, so you always see the whole sigil (and a parked animal rests the same way above its own)
Sigils on the ground can be picked up from a quarter further away

changes.title: Prop light shadows
items: Soundsystems and runestones light up the trees round them: trees and scenery near one now cast shadows away from its glow, as they do round a campfire
Clearings round soundsystems and runestones are smaller: the trees come in to about 15 m

changes.title: Ground draw
items: On foot in the forest the picture draws faster: the trees were being drawn twice over (once more for the see-through parts over the witch), and crowns hidden in the gap round her were still drawn
